children.value: Frequently Asked Questions
What pods are compatible with VOOPOO Argus kits?
Voopoo Argus Snap Replacement Pods fit every
Argus Pod Family
kit: Argus P1, P1S, P2, P3, G2, G2 Mini, G3, G3 Mini, Klyc, Matrix, Pod, Pod SE, Z and Z2. They do not fit the Argus Pro, Pro 2, GT, XT, MT or X, which use PnP pods, or the Argus E40 and Argus Air.
Are all Voopoo Argus pods the same?
No. Voopoo makes four Argus Pod Family cartridges: the original side-fill Argus Pod, the

children.title: Voopoo Argus Top-Fill V2 pod cartridges

children.value: Argus Top-Fill V2
with a silicone plug, the
Argus Snap
with a hinged cap, and the Argus Multi-Ohm pod that flips between two resistances. All share the same magnetic base, so they swap between kits.
How long do Voopoo Argus Snap pods last?
Voopoo rates each Argus Snap coil for up to
100ml of e-liquid
. In daily use at 2ml a day that is one to two weeks per pod, shorter with dark or very sweet liquids. Replace the pod when flavour fades, a draw tastes burnt, or it gurgles after a refill.
Which Voopoo Argus Snap pod resistance should I pick?
Pick
for a tight, cigarette-like MTL draw with 20mg nic salts,
for a warmer, looser MTL draw with 10mg salts, and
for a restricted lung draw on a 30W kit such as the Voopoo Argus P3 or Argus G3. If unsure, start with 0.7Ω, the pod most Argus owners use daily.
Why is my Voopoo Argus Snap pod leaking or tasting burnt?
A burnt taste on a new pod almost always means it was fired before the cotton soaked through; wait
ten minutes after filling
. Gurgling or leaking follows overfilling, a cap left open, or 70VG shortfill in an MTL pod. Fill to below the window top, snap the cap shut and store the kit upright.
Do Voopoo Argus Snap pods fit the Argus G4 or Argus Z3?
Voopoo names the Argus Pod Family on its Snap page and adds
"and more"

, without listing the Argus G4, G4 Mini or Z3 by name. Those kits ship with the Argus Multi-Ohm cartridge. Check the pod compatibility card inside your kit box before buying, or keep the Multi-Ohm pod they came with.
